io.milvus.v2.service.utility

Class OptimizeTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.utility.OptimizeTask

  • public class OptimizeTask
extends Object
    A background task that optimizes collection segments asynchronously. Tracks progress through stages, supports cancellation, and blocks on getResult(Long) until completion or timeout.

        public OptimizeTask(String collectionName,
                    String databaseName,
                    String targetSize,
                    Long timeout,
                    OptimizeTask.ExecuteFn executeFn)
        Constructs an OptimizeTask.
        Parameters:
        collectionName - the name of the collection to optimize
        databaseName - the name of the database containing the collection
        targetSize - the target segment size as a string (e.g. "512MB"), or null
        timeout - the timeout in milliseconds, or null for no timeout
        executeFn - the function that triggers the optimize operation
